Diffuse attenuation coefficients for Jerlov optical water types.

Source: R/data.R
jerlov_types.Rd

Long-format table of Kd(lambda) values for five oceanic and three coastal water types from Jerlov (1976) and Solonenko & Mobley (2015). Attributes record the supported wavelength range and spacing, a table checksum, source artifact path, build commit, model version, and package version.

Usage

jerlov_types

Format

A data frame with 120 rows and 3 columns:

type

Jerlov water type (character): "I", "IA", "IB", "II", "III" (oceanic, clearest to most turbid) and "C1", "C2", "C3" (coastal).

lambda

Wavelength in nm (350 to 700, 25 nm steps).

Kd

Diffuse attenuation coefficient in 1/m.

References

Jerlov NG (1976) Marine Optics. Elsevier, Amsterdam.

Solonenko MG, Mobley CD (2015) Inherent and apparent optical properties of Jerlov water types. Applied Optics 54(17):5392-5401.

Examples

data(jerlov_types)
subset(jerlov_types, type == "IA")
#>    type lambda    Kd
#> 16   IA    350 0.076
#> 17   IA    375 0.044
#> 18   IA    400 0.033
#> 19   IA    425 0.023
#> 20   IA    450 0.016
#> 21   IA    475 0.018
#> 22   IA    500 0.024
#> 23   IA    525 0.032
#> 24   IA    550 0.041
#> 25   IA    575 0.068
#> 26   IA    600 0.125
#> 27   IA    625 0.185
#> 28   IA    650 0.257
#> 29   IA    675 0.391
#> 30   IA    700 0.558
